description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for the CKEditor5 module, including help text, theme integration, form alterations, library management, configuration schema adjustments, entity and bundle modifications, editor presave processing, and AJAX callbacks for the CKEditor5 text editor within Drupal.

classes.name: Ckeditor5Hooks
classes.description: Drupal hook implementations for CKEditor5, managing help, theme, form, library, config, entity, bundle, editor, and AJAX integrations.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help documentation HTML for CKEditor5 module, including usage, configuration, accessibility, and migration info.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Defines theme hook for CKEditor5 settings toolbar.

methods.name: formFilterFormatFormAlter
methods.description: Alters the filter format form to make allowed HTML tags read-only for CKEditor5 and adds AJAX callbacks for form elements.

methods.name: libraryInfoAlter
methods.description: Modifies library dependencies for filter and CKEditor5 modules, including stylesheets and dialog fixes.

methods.name: jsAlter
methods.description: Alters JavaScript assets to manage CKEditor5 translation files based on current language.

methods.name: configSchemaInfoAlter
methods.description: Adjusts configuration schema definitions for CKEditor5 format and image upload settings.

methods.name: fieldWidgetSingleElementFormAlter
methods.description: Adds data attributes to text_format widget for CKEditor5 plugin behavior based on entity context.

methods.name: entityBundleInfoAlter
methods.description: Adds CKEditor5 link suggestions support to node bundles.

methods.name: editorPresave
methods.description: Pre-save hook for CKEditor5 editors to adjust plugin settings and allowed tags based on source editing and list type.

methods.name: filterFormatEditFormSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission to merge allowed HTML tags and styles for CKEditor5 configuration.

methods.name: updateCkeditor5HtmlFilter
methods.description: AJAX callback to update editor settings and validation messages dynamically based on CKEditor5 activation.

methods.name: themeCss
methods.description: Retrieves theme-specific CKEditor5 stylesheets, including theme inheritance.
